_note:
Source attribution for every image used in the Nagpur Origins story. For the eight Commons files, licence, artist and date were read on 2026-10-15 from the Commons API (imageinfo extmetadata: LicenseShortName, UsageTerms, LicenseUrl, Artist, DateTimeOriginal; and the file page's wikitext for the {{self|...}} licence, the author= field and any permission template), one call every 3 seconds, not inferred from the rendered page. Each original was downloaded with curl and its SHA-1 matched against the API before processing. The two public-domain scans come from the Internet Archive's IIIF service at full size; their items carry possible-copyright-status NOT_IN_COPYRIGHT. Processing follows the Ahmedabad plates: Pillow, Lanczos, 2000 px wide, JPEG quality 82; an image narrower than that keeps its size; crops and rotations are recorded per plate. We do not ship images without provenance.

SHARE-ALIKE ACCEPTED: the CC BY-SA photographs are modern 'own work' uploads by their photographers, so the licence grant and the authorship are consistent. Ganesh Dhamodkar's requested attribution form is used verbatim in each Figure's source line. We only resize, so no adaptation is published.

DELIBERATELY NOT USED, having been checked: the eight candidates under _rejected, each with its reason. Licence-clean alternates identified but not needed by the current text: 'File:Ambazari Lake June 2022.jpg' (CC BY-SA 4.0, Ganesh Dhamodkar, a pre-monsoon sunset) and 'File:Kanhan River near Khaparkheda Thermal Power Station.jpg' (CC BY-SA 3.0, Kmohankar, 2018; carried by the 6 Sep build). NOT FOUND on Commons: any photograph of Telankhedi tank itself, and any pre-1950 photograph of Ambazari, Gorewada, the Jumma Talao or the Nag.
